none: PAS NCL-38F843: Roman Coin: Denarius of Severus Alexander
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver hybrid of a denarius of Severus Alexander dating to AD 231 (Reece period 11). P M TR P VIIII COS III P P reverse type depicting Sol standing right, head left, raising right hand and holding globe. Mint of Rome. For reverse, dating to AD 230 see RIC IV, Pt II, p. 78, no. 102. The obverse legend IMP ALEXANDER PIVS AVG only appears on issues from AD 231
